data.body: Operator decision 2026-11-02: leave the duplicated tickets history in place; no rewrite. The authorship-gate size pressure that motivated a rewrite is gone (its limit now measures the code checkout, not the tickets branch). Recurrence prevention (writer-side guard against appending onto a related-but-diverged base, observed-tip lease at push, fail-closed check for introduced paths unreachable through local ancestry) is tracked on sericate-chitchatty-arawana. Closing as covered by that work.
